scope: Teaching prototype: our own candidate cross-attention head on a frozen pretrained Qwen backbone. Separate from the matched Unsloth comparison; no equal-tuning or head-only causal superiority claim.
precision: BF16 frozen backbone; FP32 head, logits and loss; reference Transformers runtime
schedule: constant learning rate, no warmup or validation-selected checkpoint
evaluation: Record validation accuracy descriptively; do not select settings. Fit one positive selection temperature on calibration only. Report raw and calibrated full official test metrics, with one-seed scope. Reuse seven authored demos without selecting examples by outcome.
preflight: CPU mask, permutation-at-fixed-representations, finite-gradient and serialization tests. GPU tiny-training-set fit, 100-update memory pilot, exact save/reload and one-backbone-pass checks before main training.
limitations: One seed, fixed untuned head learning rate, frozen backbone, new span prompt and different numerical runtime. This builds a working mechanism and diagnostic checkpoint; it does not extend the matched alias/Clef result table or establish a new default.
